summary: Significant bidirectional information transfer between NH and SH albedo anomalies detected. At lag=3 months: TE(NH→SH)=0.231 (p=0.0075, z=2.64), TE(SH→NH)=0.274 (p<0.001, z=6.92). Net flow is SH→NH dominant at 3-6 month lags. At lag=12 months, flow reverses to NH→SH dominant. This is the first information-theoretic evidence that hemispheric albedo anomalies are NOT independent.
